description: This file defines an abstract repository interface for user profiles and its local implementation class utilizing a local data source. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, seeding, and clearing user profile data, along with some validation logic.

classes.name: ProfileRepository
classes.description: An abstract interface defining methods for user profile operations, intended to be implemented by concrete classes.

classes.name: LocalProfileRepository
classes.description: A concrete class implementing profile management using a local data source, including methods for fetching, updating, seeding, and clearing profile data.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Fetches the user profile from local storage.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the user profile with optional new display name, email, avatar URL, and phone number.

methods.name: seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Seeds a default profile if none exists, primarily for demo or offline scenarios.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the stored profile data from local storage.
